warning: An exemption from a building permit does not waive zoning, historic, floodplain, right-of-way, utility, fire-code, contractor-licensing, or other approvals.

exemptions.rule: Ordinary minor repairs may be exempt only when they do not include regulated structural, electrical, gas, mechanical, plumbing, or fire/life-safety work.
Interior alteration or repair with no change to the building footprint does not require a residential plot plan; the underlying work may still require a permit.
Repainting or reposting the surface of an outdoor sign is exempt from the sign building-permit requirement when there is no regulated alteration or rebuilding.
Only brick, stone, rock, or similar inorganic demolition material may be buried onsite as allowed by the demolition requirements; organic or prohibited waste may not be buried.
